description: Backend foundation: FastAPI app configuration, SQLAlchemy database setup with SQLite fallback, all ORM models, all Pydantic v2 schemas, JWT auth utilities, and app config. This is the dependency base for all other backend features.
steps: Create backend/app/config.py: pydantic-settings BaseSettings class reading DATABASE_URL (default 'sqlite:///./packsmart.db'), JWT_SECRET_KEY, JWT_ALGORITHM (default 'HS256'), ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES (default 1440), ALLOWED_ORIGINS (default 'http://localhost:3000'). Use model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file='.env', extra='ignore').

Create backend/app/database.py: SQLAlchemy engine created from settings.DATABASE_URL, check_same_thread=False only for SQLite (detect via URL prefix), SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine), Base = declarative_base(), get_db() dependency yielding a session and closing on exit, init_db() calling Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine).

Create backend/app/models/user.py: User ORM model with columns id (UUID pk, default uuid4), email (unique, indexed), hashed_password, full_name, user_type (Enum: farmer/food_processor/small_business/packaging_manufacturer/researcher/admin), organization, phone_number, is_active (bool, default True), is_admin (bool, default False), created_at, updated_at.

Create backend/app/models/food.py: FoodCategory enum (fruits/vegetables/cereals/pulses/spices/dairy/meat/fish/bakery/snacks/processed_food/beverages/other). FoodProfile ORM model with id, user_id (FK to users), food_name, category, moisture_content, ph, fat_content, protein_content, water_activity, respiration_rate, perishability (enum: low/medium/high), oxygen_sensitivity, moisture_sensitivity, light_sensitivity, temperature_sensitivity, odor_sensitivity, microbial_sensitivity (all enum: low/medium/high), created_at.

Create backend/app/models/packaging.py: PackagingMaterial ORM model with id, name, material_code, category (enum: plastic/paper/metal/glass/biodegradable/multilayer/composite), moisture_barrier (float 0-1), oxygen_barrier (float 0-1), light_barrier (float 0-1), thermal_resistance (float 0-1), mechanical_strength (float 0-1), food_contact_safe (bool), recyclable (bool), biodegradable (bool), compostable (bool), bio_based (bool), cost_index (float 0-1), typical_thickness_min_um (float), typical_thickness_max_um (float), description (text), suitable_for (JSON array of food categories), created_at.

Create backend/app/models/recommendation.py: StorageConditions, PackagingRequirements, Recommendation ORM models. StorageConditions: storage_temp (float), storage_humidity (float), storage_duration_days (int), transportation_duration_days, transportation_type (enum: road/rail/air/sea), cold_chain_required (bool). PackagingRequirements: required_shelf_life_days (int), package_size (str), package_quantity (int), budget (float), packaging_type (enum: pouch/bag/bottle/tray/box/vacuum_pack/map/flexible/rigid), priority (enum: low_cost/max_shelf_life/food_safety/sustainability/balanced), eco_preference (enum: no_preference/recyclable/biodegradable/compostable/bio_based). Recommendation: id, user_id (FK), food_profile_id (FK), primary_material_id (FK), alternative_material_ids (JSON array), packaging_structure (text), barrier_properties (JSON), recommended_thickness_um (float), storage_conditions_recommended (text), shelf_life_min_days (int), shelf_life_max_days (int), risk_factors (JSON array), sustainability_score (float), cost_score (float), food_safety_score (float), overall_score (float), explanation (text), created_at.

Create backend/app/schemas/auth.py: Pydantic v2 schemas — UserCreate (full_name, email, password, user_type, organization, phone_number), UserLogin (email, password), UserResponse (id, email, full_name, user_type, organization, is_admin, created_at — model_config with from_attributes=True), Token (access_token, token_type='bearer'), TokenData (user_id, email).

Create backend/app/schemas/food.py: SensitivityLevel enum (low/medium/high), PerishabilityLevel enum (low/medium/high), FoodProfileCreate (all FoodProfile fields except id/user_id/created_at), FoodProfileResponse (all fields + id, model_config from_attributes=True).
Create backend/app/schemas/packaging.py: PackagingMaterialCreate (all material fields), PackagingMaterialResponse (all fields + id, from_attributes=True).

Create backend/app/schemas/recommendation.py: StorageConditionsInput, PackagingRequirementsInput, RecommendationRequest (food_profile_id or inline FoodProfileCreate, plus storage and packaging inputs), RecommendationResponse (full recommendation data including material details, scores, explanation, alternatives list), RecommendationListItem (summary fields for dashboard listing).

Create backend/app/utils/auth.py: get_password_hash(password) using passlib bcrypt, verify_password(plain, hashed), create_access_token(data dict, expires_delta) using python-jose JWT, get_current_user(token: str, db: Session) FastAPI dependency that decodes token and returns User ORM object, get_current_admin(current_user) dependency that raises 403 if not admin.

Create backend/app/main.py: FastAPI app with title='PackSmart AI API', version='1.0.0'. Configure CORSMiddleware with settings.ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Import and include all routers (auth, foods, packaging, recommendations, admin) each with /api prefix. Add GET /health endpoint returning {status: ok, version: 1.0.0}. On startup event: call init_db() and seed_data.run_seed(db). Include OpenAPI tags metadata.
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && python -c "from app.main import app; print('OK')" exits 0 with no import errors
All 5 ORM models import cleanly and define __tablename__
All Pydantic schemas use model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) not class Config
config.py reads DATABASE_URL with sqlite fallback when env var absent
verification: cd backend && python -c "from app.main import app; from app.database import init_db; print('Import OK')"

cd backend && python -c "from app.models.user import User; from app.models.food import FoodProfile; from app.models.packaging import PackagingMaterial; from app.models.recommendation import Recommendation; print('Models OK')"
findings: FEAT-002/003 notes: (1) The environment runs Python 3.14.2 — the pinned versions in requirements.txt are incompatible. Compatible versions installed: fastapi>=0.142, sqlalchemy>=2.1, pydantic>=2.12, pydantic-settings>=2.15, uvicorn>=0.54. psycopg2-binary cannot be built (no pg_config); SQLite fallback works fine for local dev. (2) All ORM models use String(36) primary keys (UUID stored as string) for SQLite compatibility — no postgresql-specific UUID type. (3) main.py uses @asynccontextmanager lifespan instead of deprecated @app.on_event. (4) Stub route files exist in backend/app/routes/ for auth, foods, packaging, recommendations, admin — FEAT-002 should fill these in. (5) Seed data (17 packaging materials) is in backend/app/services/seed_data.py and runs at startup. (6) All relative imports verified working. (7) Both verification commands exit 0.
